# HudProgress

Linear or ring progress that keeps a process visible.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="hud-progress" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | Required | Progress name |
| `value` | number | undefined | Leave it out, or pass a non-finite number, for indeterminate progress |
| `max` | number | 100 | Upper bound; invalid values fall back to 100 |
| `variant` | 'bar' \| 'ring' | 'bar' | Display style |

## Keyboard and usage notes

Read-only progress uses progressbar semantics; the value is clamped to 0–max, and indeterminate progress leaves out aria-valuenow.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmHudProgress } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yunyoujun.cn/r/hud-progress.json
```
